script_name: EasyTube V3 — Ad Skip, SponsorBlock & HD Download⬇️🚀
summary: The script transmits YouTube video IDs and possibly metadata to third-party APIs (SponsorBlock and Cobalt instances) for ad skipping and video downloading. No evidence of sensitive user data collection, remote code execution, obfuscation, or DOM XSS. Supply chain risk exists due to reliance on external Cobalt endpoints. Overall, the script is reasonably safe for its purpose, but users should be aware of third-party data transmission and supply chain risks.
